title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: A permission no code can exercise
summary: RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED was reported as a permission nothing exercises. Nothing in an app code ever can: it is exercised by a receiver declared in a manifest, usually a library one. WorkManager declares such a receiver and requires this permission.

highlights.title: A finding that broke background work
highlights.description: Acting on it stops periodic work from resuming after a restart. On the project measured, the permission comment reads: need to do cleanup during the night and background download.

highlights.title: A test that pinned the wrong answer
highlights.description: The suite used this very permission as its example of one that nothing exercises. It now uses CAMERA, which really does need a runtime request in code.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: The permission joins those complete with their declaration alone, next to WAKE_LOCK and FOREGROUND_SERVICE, exempt for the same reason.
One finding remains on the project measured, an intent extra written and never read anywhere. That one is real.
